about_the_game:
Nurture a small forest under siege by lumberjacks in this cozy tower defense game. Plant and upgrade trees with unique abilities to protect your grove, customize and decorate your forest, and unwind with the soothing escape of building a natural haven from a single tree.

Grove was made to be played before bed. I avoided using blue light and bright colors, and most audio is synchronized to occur on beat with the music. I hope it brings you some peace!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-4100
  • Graphics: Integrated Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: Not applicable
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: Not applicable
  • Additional Notes: For best experience, use a computer with discrete graphics.

short_description: A cozy tower defense game designed to help you relax before bed. Nurture a small forest under siege by lumberjacks or create your own grove in peaceful mode.
